title: Interactive Sandbox & Roleplay Demo Scripts for Dedicated/Private Launch
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a hands-on interactive sandbox and a set of roleplay demo scripts targeted at Sales and Customer Success to accelerate proof-of-value conversations for Dedicated and Private offerings. The sandbox should let reps toggle tenancy (hosted vs dedicated vs private), simulate KMS/HSM onboarding, step through RBAC flows, and exercise autoscale/overprovision scenarios with deterministic latency/cost readouts. Scripts should be short, modular (5–8 minute segments), and include objection-handling lines, outcomes to measure, and guided admin tasks for CS-led POC sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive sandbox deployed in staging with three pre-configured scenarios: 'Quick POC (hosted->dedicated)', 'Security-first (VPC + KMS)', 'Scale test (reserved capacity + autoscale)'.
At least 6 roleplay scripts (sales and CS variants), each 5-8 minutes long, with explicit demo steps, expected outputs, and 3 common objection responses.
Sandbox UI exposes toggles for model variant, quantization profile, batching policy, and KV cache demo mode; each toggle updates live latency/cost estimate panel.
Linked artifacts: Confluence PRD, Drive demo recording (sample run), and a ready-to-run GitHub repo with terraform/staging deployment and sample workload generator.
Enablement session scheduled with Sales and CS (30-minute hands-on) and follow-up survey with target > 80% 'useful' rating from participants.
success_metrics: Number of reps who complete sandbox playbook in first 2 weeks >= 60
Conversion lift: deals that used the sandbox in discovery convert 10% faster vs baseline
CS ramp time: median onboarding time for new CS hires using the scripts reduced by 20%

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sandbox doesn't reflect production performance -> Mitigation: use representative instance types and telemetry from runtime-1.20 canary runs to seed estimates.
Risk: Security-sensitive demo elements (KMS/RBAC) blocked in staging -> Mitigation: use mocked KMS flow with recorded audit logs and clearly labeled simulated steps.
Risk: Sales time constraints reduce adoption -> Mitigation: produce 3-minute 'quick win' script and integrate into weekly SDR standups.
